minutes_text:
INGLEWOOD TRANSIT CONNECTOR JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY
  MEETING MINUTES
  OCTOBER 12, 2022

The Inglewood Transit Connector Joint Powers Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held
a regular meeting on Wednesday, October 12, 2022, conducted virtually.

1. CALL TO ORDER.

The Secretary called the Inglewood Transit Connector Joint Powers Authority into session at the
hour of 2:00 p.m.

1.a. ROLL CALL.

The Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

Present:  Mike Bohlke, Artie Fields, Alternate Debra Avila, and Alternate Timothy Lindholm;
  and
Absent:  Sharon Gookin, Bryan Pennington, and Angela George-Moody

1.b. RESOLUTION NO. 22-06 ADOPTED – MAKING FINDINGS AND DETERMINATIONS UNDER AB
361 AUTHORIZING VITURAL BOARD MEETING.

Staff report dated October 12, 2022, was presented recommending the adoption of a Resolution
making finding and determinations under AB 361 authorizing virtual meetings pursuant to AB
361.

It was moved by Director Artie Fields and seconded by Alternate Timothy Lindholm. The motion
was carried by the following roll call vote:

Ayes:  Directors Artie Fields, Alternate Debra Avila, Alternate Timothy Lindholm, and
  Chair Mike Bohlke
Noes:  None; and
Absent:  Directors Sharon Gookin, Bryan Pennington, and Angela George-Moody

2. CHAIR’S COMMENTS.
Chair Bohlke provided comments.
3. PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.
Secretary Aisha L. Thompson inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address
the Inglewood Transit Connector Joint Powers Authority on any item on the Agenda.
No individuals requested to speak.
 4. ADOPTION OF MINUTES FROM THE MEETING HELD ON SEPTEMBER 14, 2022.
Staff report dated October 12, 2022, was presented recommending the adoption of the Minutes
of the Meeting held on September 14, 2022.
It was moved by Director Artie Fields, and seconded by Alternate Timothy Lindholm. The motion
was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes:  Directors Artie Fields, Alternate Debra Avila, Alternate Timothy Lindholm, and
  Chair Mike Bohlke
Noes:  None; and
Absent:  Directors Sharon Gookin, Bryan Pennington, and Angela George-Moody

5. REPORT RECEIVED AND FILED – INGLEWOOD TRANSIT CONNECTOR PROJECT MONTHLY
PROGRESS REPORT.
Lisa Trifiletti presented a brief oral report on Inglewood Transit Connector Project Monthly
Progress.
Chair Bohlke ordered the presentation received and filed.

Director Sharon Gookin arrived at the hour of 2:19 p.m.

7. RESOLUTION NO. 22-08 ADOPTED – ESTABLISING A RECORDS RETENTION POLICY.
Alfred Smith presented a staff report dated October 12, 2022, recommending adoption of a
Resolution establishing a Records Retention Policy for the Inglewood Transit Connector Joint
Powers Authority.
It was moved by Director Artie Fields, and seconded by Alternate Timothy Lindholm. The motion
was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes:  Directors Artie Fields, Sharon Gookin, Alternate Timothy Lindholm, and Chair Mike
  Bohlke
Noes:  None; and
Absent:  Directors Bryan Pennington and Angela George-Moody

6. RESOLUTION NO. 22-07 ADOPTED – ADOPTION OF A FISCAL YEAR 2023 BUDGET.
Sharon Koike presented a staff report dated October 12, 2022, recommending adoption of a
Resolution of a Fiscal Year 2023 Budget for the Inglewood Transit Connector Joint Powers
Authority.
 It was moved by Director Artie Fields, and seconded by Director Sharon Gookin. The motion was
carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes:  Directors Artie Fields, Sharon Gookin, Alternate Timothy Lindholm, and Chair Mike
  Bohlke
Noes:  None; and
Absent:  Directors Bryan Pennington and Angela George-Moody

8. REPORT RECEIVED AND FILED – ADOPTION OF KAHUA SYSTEM AS THE “SYSTEMS OF
RECORD”.

Brian Boudreau presented a staff report dated October 12, 2022, recommending the adoption of
Kahua System as the “Systems of Record” for the Inglewood Transit Connector Project.

Chair Bohlke ordered the staff report received and filed.

9. REPORT RECEIVED AND FILED – THE INTERIM STAFFING PLAN.

Louis Atwell presented a staff report dated October 12, 2022, regarding the Interim Staffing Plan
for the Inglewood Transit Connector Project.

Chair Bohlke ordered the staff report received and filed.

10. BOARD MEMBER COMMENTS.

No comments were made.

11. PUBLIC REMARKS.

Secretary Aisha L. Thompson inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address
the Inglewood Transit Connector Joint Powers Authority on any matter not elsewhere considered
on the Agenda.

No individuals requested to speak.

11. ADJOURNMENT.

There being no further business to be presented, Chair Bohlke declared the meeting adjourned
at the hour of 2:40 p.m.
  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary

  ________________________
  Mike Bohlke, Chair
